detail.longDescription: So I have a script that can hide various id elements in a select drop-down based on a radio button. But it currently only hides one of the ids in the dropdown. How do I hide the others. I click on "Human", I want all the IDs that are NOT human to vanish. But it only vanishes the FIRST of each ID. So if I click "Human", it just removes "Diablo", "Dracula" and "London". I need it to ALSO remove "Messenger", "Daeva" and "Irraka" I'm using Javascript Edit: The code: <script> var raceArray=["Human","Demon","Vampire","Werewolf"]; function species(z){ for (x=0;x<raceArray.length();x++) { var hide_race = document.getElementById(raceArray[x]); hide_race.hidden=true; } var show_race = document.getElementById(raceArray[z]); show_race.hidden=false; } HTML: <input type="radio" onclick="species(0)">Human <input type="radio" onclick="species(1)">Demon <input type="radio" onclick="species(1)">Vampire <input type="radio" onclick="species(2)">Werewolf <select id="race"> <option id="Human">Human</option> <option id="Demon">Diablo</option> <option id="Demon">Messenger</option> <option id="Vampire">Dracula</option> <option id="Vampire">Daeva</option> <option id="Werewolf">London</option> <option id="Werewolf">Irraka</option> </select>
